name: Image quality and prompt adherence
description: Visually grades the generated image against the requested scene and checks composition, clarity, and artifacts.

messages.content:
Inspect the attached generated image. Requested image: {{input.prompt}}
Evaluate visible adherence to every requested subject, color, object count, composition, and style (70%), plus visual quality, clarity, and absence of unwanted artifacts or text (30%). Do not infer success from the prompt or metadata: judge the actual pixels. Give a concise explanation of what matches and what does not. Choose Excellent for near-complete adherence and clean execution, Good for minor issues, Partial for substantial omissions, Poor for a mostly incorrect image, or Fail for an unusable image.
